title: BLK Art Auction
challenge: A timed art-auction experience needed to keep lot discovery, bidder accounts, auction states, payment, and delivery steps understandable in one journey.
contribution: Built and refined responsive auction interfaces, account-aware states, and API-connected flows that carried bidders from browsing a lot through post-auction actions.
outcome: Created a clearer end-to-end bidding experience with consistent states across discovery, participation, and fulfilment.

title: Whizlabs
challenge: Practice tests, video courses, hands-on labs, and cloud sandboxes needed to feel like parts of one scalable learning platform.
contribution: Developed reusable learning and dashboard interfaces, connected API-driven states, and maintained responsive patterns across different content formats.
outcome: Helped deliver a more consistent learner journey across discovery, enrolment, progress tracking, and hands-on practice.

title: Alero
challenge: A static product website needed a more useful way to answer visitor questions and guide people toward the right next step.
contribution: Integrated an interactive, API-driven conversational experience with clear response, loading, recovery, and conversion states.
outcome: Turned passive browsing into a guided product journey while keeping the experience responsive and easy to navigate.

title: Tech Point Services
challenge: Visitors needed to find the right public-service assistance, understand required documents, and move confidently toward support in more than one language.
contribution: Created responsive service-discovery flows, document-preparation states, multilingual interface patterns, and a direct support handoff.
outcome: Made service selection and preparation easier to understand before a visitor started the assisted process.
